titleText: Malta must avoid 'two-speed society' as government unveils new AI strategy
mainText: From Times of Malta: Malta must avoid 'two-speed society' as government unveils new AI strategy. Revamped strategy includes 86 measures to promote AI adoption and improve public services

titleText: Man jailed 15 years for raping, exploiting three girls and cannabis trafficking
mainText: From Times of Malta: Man jailed 15 years for raping, exploiting three girls and cannabis trafficking. The 30-year-old man admitted to seven charges, including trafficking the minors

titleText: Equality Minister inaugurates red bench to commemorate female victims of gender-based violence
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Equality Minister inaugurates red bench to commemorate female victims of gender-based violence. At an event organised by the Italian Embassy, Equality Minister Rosianne Cutajar inaugurated a symbolic red bench, known as the "Panchina Rossa," in remembrance of the women who have died due to gender-based violence.

titleText: VAT inspections stopped for election month
mainText: From MaltaToday: VAT inspections stopped for election month. No VAT inspections took place in May, the month of the general election, figures tabled in parliament by Finance Minister Clyde Caruana show. And in April, when the expectation of a general election was high, VAT inspections dropped to a mere 26.
